title: Greenbrix C5: 5 moments a bridge loan saves the deal
topic: Bridge and short-term financing: 5 moments a bridge loan saves the deal
hook: The money is coming. The deadline came first.
logline: Seven-slide Greenbrix Capital carousel for Krystian Catala: 5 moments a bridge loan saves the deal.
structure: 7 slides: whole arch between 'Your deadline' and 'Your funds' (right foot runs off the edge as swipe cue), SOLD / FOR SALE lawn signs with a gap arch, split-flap status board (Lender: pulled out), cheque stamped DUE NOW, giant 90% over ten bricks with the tenth missing, joined arch across slides 6-7. Fields alternate so no two neighbours match until the joined finale.
device: masonry arch of the logo's dark-to-lime bricks with a lime keystone; the arch crosses the seam between slides 6 and 7 and lands at 'Funds arrive' where Krystian stands
lessons: No rates, fees or terms appear, so no placeholders were needed.
